evidence_state_legend.VERIFIED: Exact behavior or artifact identity validated by a recorded gate.
evidence_state_legend.RECORDED_TESTS: A source records passing tests; release-specific revalidation may remain separate.
evidence_state_legend.REVIEWED: Source or design inspected; execution is not implied.
evidence_state_legend.BLOCKED: A required execution or authority plane was unavailable or prohibited.
evidence_state_legend.GENERATED: Artifact created; verification and publication are separate.
evidence_state_legend.DEPLOYED: Runtime deployment exists; business impact is not implied.
evidence_state_legend.UNVERIFIED: No qualifying validation receipt exists for the current revision.
